title: Periodic ground states for a one-parameter family of nonlocal energies on the real line
summary: In dimension one, we introduce a one-parameter family of nonlocal energies, including subcritical Gagliardo seminorms and Riesz functionals, acting on scalar functions whose derivative is given by a periodic configuration of screened Dirac masses. We prove that the global minimizers are given by the equi-spaced configurations of particles.
